Ghar mein ek roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hai. Har hisse ka ek naam hota hai. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Rang wala ek hissa poori roti ka 1/4 hai. Poore ke barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 8/1 sahi nahi hai. 1/4 mein neeche wala 4 batata hai ki roti kitne barabar hisson mein bati. Ab bagal wali roti ke hisse gino. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/8 hissa

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Do pattiyan dekho, dono ke 3 hisse. A ke teeno hisse barabar hain, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse chhote-bade hain, toh unhe gin kar 1/3 nahi keh sakte. Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: teeno

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Dono pattiyon ke teen hisse, par barabar sirf pehli ke. Pehli ka har hissa 1/3 hai; doosri ke chhote bade hisson ko 1/3 nahi keh sakte. 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: 1 hai na

Sahi jawab, kyunki 24 cm ka 1/3 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cm hai, aur 8 cm ka hissa sirf 1 hai. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hisson wali 15 cm ki patti mein, kaunsa hissa 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: 5 wala

Haan, sahi hai. Patti ke teen barabar hisse 5-5 cm ke hote. Ab do ribbon lo: P 20 cm ki, Q 12 cm ki. P ka 1/2 10 cm hai, aur Q ka 1/2 6 cm. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: 2 cm zyada

Bilkul sahi: P ka 1/4 5 cm, Q ka sirf 3 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ab dekhna hai ki ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai. Ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata, yeh kis hisaab se nikaaloge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: 27 ko 6 se bhaag

Nahi, yeh nahi hai. Hisson ki ginti ke liye 30 ko 6 se bhaag denge, kyunki dekhna hai ki 30 cm mein 6 cm kitni baar aata hai. Dhyaan rakhna, fractional unit ke neeche hisse ki lambai 6 nahi aati; neeche woh ginti aati hai ki ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/6 sahi nahi hai. Pehle 30 cm mein 6 cm ke hisse gino. Phir yaad karo, roti ke ek hisse ka naam uske barabar hisse gin kar kaise diya tha. 30 cm ke ganne ka 6 cm wala ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: ek-paanchvaan

Haan, bilkul theek. Suno, 30 ÷ 6 = 5 barabar hisse bane, aur neeche hisson ki ginti aati hai, hisse ki lambai nahi. Toh poora jawab: ek hissa poore ganne ka 1/5 hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 5 cm hai, kyunki Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5. Ab ek hi poore ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar hisson mein baantenge, aur dekhenge ki ek hissa kaise badalta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: do hisse

Haan, bilkul theek: har 1/3 jitni jagah mein do 1/6. Ab teen chocolate ki pattiyan lo, teeno ek hi size ki. Pehli 3 doston mein barabar bati, doosri 5 mein, teesri 10 mein. Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. In pattiyon ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

director.text: ek bata das

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 doston wala hissa sabse chhota, phir 5 wala, phir 3 wala, toh 1/10 sabse chhota. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek patti barabar baantni hai. Hissa 1/3 se chhota par 1/6 se bada chahiye, aur dost 2, 4 ya 7 ho sakte hain. Dekhna hai kitne dost theek rahenge. Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge.

director.text: Haan, pehle har dost ka hissa, har option mein. Ab har hissa do baaton par jaanchna hai: woh 1/3 se chhota ho, aur 1/6 se bada. Patti jitne zyada doston mein bate, hissa utna chhota. Tumhari baari: toh patti kitne doston mein baantoge, 2, 4 ya 7?
director.card: Tumhari baari: toh patti kitne doston mein baantoge, 2, 4 ya 7?

Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: patti 4 doston mein baanto. Har hissa 1/4 hai, jo 1/3 se chhota aur 1/6 se bada hai. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/6 cake se chhota chahiye. Kam se kam kitne hisse karne honge?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki 6 hisse dete theek 1/6; chhota hissa 6 se zyada hisson par milta hai, aur sabse kam 7, yaani 1/7. Ek hi raste par cycle ne raste ka 1/6 hissa tay kiya, scooter ne 1/8, aur bus ne 1/7. Sabse zyada door kaun gaya: cycle, scooter ya bus?

Bilkul sahi: teeno mein 1/5 ke liye poora sabse kam, 5, hisson mein bata, toh 1/5 sabse bada; 1/8 sabse chhota. Ab ek se zyada cheezein barabar baantenge, jaise kuch roti kuch bachchon mein, aur har ek ka hissa bhinn mein likhenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh bhinn wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Ab yeh kaam poora karte hain. 3 roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hain. Har roti ke 4 barabar hisse karo, aur har bachche ko har roti se ek hissa do, yaani 1/4. Teen roti se teen hisse milte hain: 3/4 roti. Ab bachche wahi 4 hain, par roti sirf 2. Ek bachche ke hisse mein kitni roti aayegi?

Jitni roti hain, har bachche ko utne hi hisse milte hain. 4 roti 7 bachchon mein barabar baanti gayi. Ek bachche ke paas kitni roti pahunchi?

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki har roti se 1/7, aur roti 4, toh 4/7; roti upar, bachche neeche. Cricket wali baat batao na, tumhe uski kaunsi baat pasand hai?

Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
